name: color-picker
title: Color picker
description: A saturation-brightness area, hue (and alpha) sliders, a hex field and a two-theme preview of the primary button with its contrast.

when: Choosing a brand or theme color, where contrast in both themes matters.

instead.when: Space is tight and people know the hex.

keyboard.does: Move the area thumb or a slider by one step.

builtIn: The label names the area, each slider and the hex field.
The preview announces the contrast ratio and what the theme uses when a tone fails.

ColorPicker.name: label
ColorPicker.description: "Brand color"; names the area, the sliders and the hex field for screen readers.

ColorPicker.name: value
ColorPicker.description: The hex ("#1E63D0"); "#1E63D0CC" with an alpha channel.

ColorPicker.name: onChange
ColorPicker.description: While dragging and typing: the preview and its contrast check follow every move.

ColorPicker.name: onChangeEnd
ColorPicker.description: On release (and when the hex field commits): save here, not on every move.

ColorPicker.name: channels
ColorPicker.description: The sliders under the area: hue always, alpha when the color may be translucent.

ColorPicker.name: theme
ColorPicker.description:
The rest of the project's theme input (secondary, radius…): the preview shows the primary button as
`createTheme({ ...theme, primary })` derives it.

ColorPicker.name: showPreview
ColorPicker.description: Hide the two-theme preview (the picker inside ColorSwatchPicker shows its own caption).
